name: short content, no truncation
why: content shorter than the window keeps the whole string; offsets are absolute.

input.content: 明天去哈尔滨，记得带外套。

expect.text: 明天去哈尔滨，记得带外套。

name: long content, match in the middle
why: 32-char context before and after, both sides truncated with an ellipsis.

name: match near the start, right side padded to the full window
why: start cannot go below 0, so the window extends to the right.

name: match near the end, left side padded to the full window
why: end is clamped to content length, so the window slides left.

name: multiple occurrences are all highlighted
why: every case-insensitive occurrence inside the window becomes a highlight range.

input.content: 他说哈尔滨冷，我说哈尔滨也行。

expect.text: 他说哈尔滨冷，我说哈尔滨也行。

name: case-insensitive latin match
why: matching is case-insensitive; highlights keep the original casing.

input.content: We talked about HARBIN and harbin again.

expect.text: We talked about HARBIN and harbin again.

name: no match falls back to a head preview
why: no match: head of the message plus an ellipsis, no highlights.
